items.t: Uber’s Driverless Lucid Tests Begin. Lucid’s Robotaxi Order Now Tops Two Years of Deliveries
items.sum: Key TakeawaysUber and Nuro have started testing driverless Lucid Gravity robotaxis in the Bay Area, ahead of a commercial launch now planned for the first quarter of 2027. Uber also has robotaxi deals with Rivian and others, but its order for at least 35,000 Lucid vehicles is bigger than everything Lucid delivered in 2025 and the first nine months of 2026 combined.

items.t: Lucid Sinks 13% in a Week as the Tech Selloff Hits EV Stocks. Seaport Sets a $1 Target
items.sum: Key TakeawaysLucid fell 13% in the past week, mostly in Friday’s tech selloff, which also hit Rivian and Tesla. Seaport initiated coverage with a Sell and a $1 target the same morning Lucid, Nuro and Uber began driverless robotaxi tests.

items.t: Applied Digital Dropped 14% in a Week Despite a $5.4 Billion Lease. Lucid Still Sees 227% Upside
items.sum: Key TakeawaysApplied Digital stock fell 14% in the past week alongside its tenant CoreWeave, even after signing a new $5. 4 billion hyperscaler lease.

items.t: Lucid Group (LCID) Starts Driverless Robotaxi Testing, Is It A Bargain?
items.sum: Lucid Group (LCID) just moved its Gravity robotaxi program into fully driverless testing with Nuro and Uber in the San Francisco Bay Area, marking a concrete step toward commercial autonomous ride hailing. items.t: Lucid (LCID) Stock Still Trades At A Premium Following A 99% Slide
